Its composition is LiNi0.8Fe0.05Al0.15O2[3], so its iron and aluminium contents are the Fe and Al amounts in that formula. The text gives the iron content of NFA-A as containing 5,[4] (percent iron). Table Table 1[5] gives the c lattice parameter for the Al-rich NFA row, which corresponds to NFA-A, as 14.2232(4)[6].
